name: Fun-002 | DoIt Process Vultr Pending Charges

input.sql:
SELECT
  "usage_date"                AS event_time,
  "fixed.service_description" AS service_description,
  "label.description"         AS description,
  "metric.cost"               AS cost,
  "metric.usage"              AS usage
FROM BI_EXTERNAL.DOIT.VULTR_PENDING_CHARGES_DAILY__DOIT_FORMAT
WHERE DATE(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP("usage_date")) > TO_DATE('#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_db_table","line":"f5ba2aa8","path":["records",{"path_element_type":"current_item"},"9ae1f376_81da_4b86_b2a9_b57eaa398ac1"]}')}')
ORDER BY TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP("usage_date") DESC;
